update.summary: ELBO-TDS假设短期变化围绕相对稳定的用户/商品因素发生。它不只对齐增广表示：固定单位方差的encoder后验经重参数采样，decoder保留个体特征，跨视图prior约束抑制暂态噪声；任务预测只用原始观测的确定性均值。统计特征做分桶邻域扰动，序列随机mask，类别embedding dropout，再用全局特征选择限制增广强度。 本地L1只实现Eq3–7/Algorithm1的小型双encoder/decoder与dot-product预测器、单位高斯重参数采样和slot级增广。输入为调用者给定的分桶ID或已嵌入浮点slot：不读取生产特征或学习真实稳定因素。slot选择、各slot独立mask、MSE的元素均值是显式本地配置；没有完整字段embedding/dropout分组、时序增量trainer、MMoE、私有排序链路或公开benchmark效果比较。

comparison.position: The L1 component implements a small dual encoder/decoder with dot-product prediction, unit-Gaussian reparameterization and slot-level augmentation for Equations3–7/Algorithm1. Callers provide bucket IDs or embedded floating slots; no production features or true stable factors are read. Slot selection, independent slot masking and element-mean MSE are explicit local choices. Complete field embedding/dropout grouping, chronological incremental training, MMoE, private ranking and public benchmark comparisons are absent.
comparison.tradeoff: COTTI uses a differentiable CPC gate for regular/promotional-view consistency, history-distance RW weights and serving-time ABA calibration. ELBO-TDS instead constrains stable factors through a multi-view Gaussian prior and input reconstruction, leaving supervised prediction on original observations; it has no ABA-style serving probability correction. Both rely on stable-semantics assumptions. Alignment or reconstruction does not establish causal identifiability, and different production A/B experiments do not establish a head-to-head winner.

english.update: ELBO-TDS assumes short-term fluctuations around relatively stable user/item factors. It does more than align augmented representations: unit-variance encoder posteriors are reparameterized, decoders retain individual features, and cross-view priors suppress transient noise. Task prediction uses deterministic means from original observations. Statistical buckets are perturbed locally, sequence inputs masked and categorical embeddings dropped, gated by global feature selection. The L1 component implements a small dual encoder/decoder with dot-product prediction, unit-Gaussian reparameterization and slot-level augmentation for Equations3–7/Algorithm1. Callers provide bucket IDs or embedded floating slots; no production features or true stable factors are read. Slot selection, independent slot masking and element-mean MSE are explicit local choices. Complete field embedding/dropout grouping, chronological incremental training, MMoE, private ranking and public benchmark comparisons are absent.
